annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes cash-oriented rummy applications by presenting signup bonuses and account creation as ways to receive monetary or game-related benefits. It links regular play and deposits with earning income and represents that withdrawals can be made within two minutes. The displayed cash-game entries, add-cash and withdrawal controls, and referral rewards reinforce the solicitation to participate.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video presents participation in rummy applications, including regular play and daily deposits, as a route to earning money and making withdrawals. This is the best-grounded supplied subtype because an app-based activity is explicitly linked to cash claims, although the activity is rummy gameplay rather than a conventional survey or reading task.
